name: What are the steps for a professional interior paint job?

step.name: Step 1: Initial Consultation and Color Selection
step.text: This is where we chat about your vision! We'll discuss your desired outcome, the mood you want to create, and help you choose the perfect colors that complement your home's lighting and decor. We can offer expert advice on paint types and finishes. This step usually takes a day or two to finalize your choices.

step.name: Step 2: Protecting Your Home and Furniture
step.text: Before any paint can touch a wall, extensive preparation is key. This means meticulously covering all furniture, flooring, and fixtures with tarps and plastic sheeting. Protecting your belongings ensures a clean job site and prevents accidental spills or splatters. This critical step typically takes a few hours to a full day, depending on the room size and furnishings.

step.name: Step 3: Surface Preparation: Cleaning and Repair
step.text: This is arguably the most important step for a lasting finish. We clean the walls, removing dirt, grease, and cobwebs. Then, we meticulously inspect for any imperfections like nail holes, cracks, or dents. These are carefully filled, sanded smooth, and patched to create a flawless surface for painting. This prep work can take anywhere from half a day to several days for larger or more damaged areas.

step.name: Step 4: Priming the Surfaces
step.text: Once repairs are complete and surfaces are smooth, we apply a high-quality primer. Priming creates a uniform base for the paint, ensures better adhesion, and helps achieve a richer, more consistent color, especially when changing from a dark to a light shade or covering stains. This step typically takes a few hours to a day, including drying time.

step.name: Step 5: Applying the Finish Coats
step.text: Now for the fun part: applying the paint! We use professional-grade brushes and rollers, applying multiple thin, even coats for the best coverage and durability. Our painters pay close attention to detail, ensuring crisp lines and no drips or streaks. This stage can take one to three days, depending on the number of coats and the size of the area.

step.name: Step 6: Clean-Up and Final Inspection
step.text: Once the paint is dry, we carefully remove all protective coverings, clean up any debris, and put furniture back in its place. A thorough final inspection is conducted to ensure every detail meets our high standards and your complete satisfaction. This final step usually takes a few hours, leaving your home with beautifully transformed walls. Following these steps ensures a paint job that not only looks fantastic but also stands the test of time, reflecting the quality work Affordable Home Remodeling is known for.
